# Rilla Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Six years old by the end of Volume 5  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>
- **Rank:** Child  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** Ingleside, Glen St. Mary, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v5 c3 P1](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Child / Pupil  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rilla  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Rilla is a fat, roly-poly little creature with curly red hair and hazel eyes that wrinkle up when she goes to sleep. She speaks with a lisp and is known for her plumpness and vanity in dressing up. She takes great pride in wearing her best clothes, such as her embroidered white dress, blue sash, and elaborate hat adorned with silk, lace, and flowers.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)_

## Personality

Rilla is a cheerful, somewhat vain, and easily frightened young girl who takes pride in her fine attire. She is conscious of her looks and clothes, sometimes walking with a self-satisfied strut. Despite her timid nature when faced with unexpected threats, she tries to be dutiful and faithful to instructions given by adults.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014)_

- Vain about her clothes  <sub>[v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)</sub>

## Goals

- To deliver a basket of strawberries safely to the manse  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007)</sub>

## History

Rilla Blythe is the youngest child of Dr. Gilbert Blythe and Anne Shirley, growing up at Ingleside in Glen St. Mary. During the summer when she was six years old, Susan Baker dressed her in fine clothes to carry a basket of fresh strawberries to the manse as a gift for Mr. Meredith. At the manse gate, she encountered Mary Vance, who tried to take the basket from her. When Rilla refused to give it up, Mary chased her down the Glen street while brandishing a large dried codfish. Terrified, Rilla fled until she stumbled into a mud puddle, ruining her finest dress, slippers, and hat, while dropping the strawberries. Miss Cornelia rescued her and took her home, where Susan Baker cleaned her up and comforted her.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P15](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0015), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)_
